summary.description: Twenty years in the software development industry with ten focused in engineering management of teams up to 20. Proven track record of delivering complex projects on time and under budget in Agile environments. Extensive experience hiring, retaining, mentoring, and upskilling software engineers and building great engineering cultures.

responsibilities.1: Launched the 0x API v2 and implemented support processes around it, delivering a 99.82% uptime.
responsibilities.2: Reformed hiring process to eliminate bottlenecks and reduce time-to-hire by 30%; coached managers and VPs on recruiting and retaining a globally remote team.
responsibilities.3: Coached product leaders through roadmap exercises and instituted a prioritization framework resulting in a 100% delivery rate of high priority items on or ahead of schedule.
responsibilities.4: Introduced a security response process and SLA for vulnerable dependencies which reduced API wide attack surface by more than 90% for critical and high priority issues without delaying deliverables.

responsibilities.5: Launched V2 of Tracer's SaaS analytics product, reducing compute costs by 20%.
responsibilities.6: Planned and directed the replacement of a legacy front-end application with an all-Typescript/React UI leveraging agile methodologies to deliver with zero downtime or feature loss.
responsibilities.7: Developed a technical strategy around tech-debt and performance optimization; led a team of 15 in is execution, resulting in performance gains of ~15%.
responsibilities.8: Coached other managers driving company-wide implementation of engineering best practices reducing defect rate to less than 2%.
responsibilities.9: Recruited and retained a global engineering organization focused on Python and React development with 95% retention over 3 years.

responsibilities.10: Managed two security and compliance engineering teams in the US and South America totaling 16 engineers delivering KYC/AML microservices and user-facing solutions.
responsibilities.11: Transformed an under-performing C# and C++ team into one that hit sprint commitments 100% of the time while maintaining velocity through agile coaching and technical leadership.
responsibilities.12: Defined and implemented recruting, evaluation/leveling, and retention processes for newly-remote teams; hired 40+ developers into the engineering organization.
responsibilities.13: Restructured organization-wide approach to versioning and implemented a CI/CD process, tripling release frequency and cutting time-to-merge by 20%.
responsibilities.14: Launched v1 of Voice - a web3 social media application - on time, under budget, and with zero release-blocking defects.

responsibilities.15: Directed execution of a $4.3M project in collaboration with the US Department of Energy; delivered on time and under budget.
responsibilities.16: Designed and delivered a groundbreaking cryptographic isolation technique which made product/market fit possible and allowed profitable operation of the project at-scale across multiple clients.
responsibilities.17: Introduced and up-skilled the backend development team on GitOps & DevOps with Terraform, improving scaling time by 3 orders of magnitude.
responsibilities.18: Prioritized and led addition of CI/CD and acceptance testing tooling, deploying backend (C#) and frontend (TypeScript/Angular) in as little as 20 minutes.
responsibilities.19: Cultivated a close-knit, collaborative team culture which resulted in a 0% loss rate of engineering employees to regional competitors.

responsibilities.20: Launched a C# and Angular, white-label, fintech application which handles hundreds of millions of dollars in loan documents.
responsibilities.21: Recruited and trained a small development team focused on Javascript, Angular, and C#.
responsibilities.22: Introduced test driven development, Agile, and SOLID principles to the company; set company records for reliability and release frequency.

responsibilities.23: Built and demonstrated prototype cloud orchestration technology to investors.
responsibilities.24: Set and implemented unit-testing standards for development team using JMock and JUnit.

responsibilities.25: Extensive use of Javascript/AJAX, JSON, and XML based messaging for asynchronous communications.
responsibilities.26: HIPAA compliant database design and PII segregation for healthcare clients.

responsibilities.27: Tested and refactored/rearchitected MS-SQL database application to improve performance by ~400%.

responsibilities.29: Highly test-oriented LAMP stack development with substantial database architecture responsibilities.
responsibilities.30: Implemented a prototype asynchronous Javascript based framework (later replaced with AJAX).
